current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架DSGNN，采用“领导-工作者”模式，领导节点负责图划分和模型同步更新，工作者节点基于图摘要技术进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network training framework DSGNN based on graph summarization, adopting a leader-worker mode where the leader performs graph partitioning and synchronous model updates, and workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results via an attention layer.
source_locations: abstract: DSGNN模型采用“领导——工作者”工作模式...
作者贡献段2: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN...
technical_features: 采用“领导-工作者”工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分，并将子图分配给工作节点
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: The leader partitions the original graph using an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm and assigns subgraphs to workers
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
The leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes

current_task.description: 本轮针对查新点NP-2（基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架DSGNN）进行英文文献检索，旨在补充该查新点最终有效证据数量不足的问题。需要重点查找与“分布式图神经网络训练(distributed graph neural network training)”、“图摘要(graph summarization)”、“小批量训练(mini-batch training)”、“领导-工作者模式(leader-worker mode)”、“注意力机制(attention mechanism)在分布式训练中的应用”相关的英文文献，以验证该框架的创新性与差异性。
